name: gs7-bathurst-bridge
js: (() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP, C = window.CITY; app.teleportTo(-1720, 40, 0); const y0 = C.deckHeightAt(-1750, 40, 20, 20); app.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [-1750, y0 + 3.2, 40], look: [-1500, y0 + -4, 60], fov: 55 }); })()

name: ride5-strachan-under
js: (() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP, C = window.CITY; let X = -2532, Z = -280;  app.selectMode('cyclist'); app.teleportTo(X, Z, 0); const e = app.controllerManager.getActiveEntity(); const t0 = performance.now(); let last = -1, maxDy = 0, py = null; const id = setInterval(() => { const t = (performance.now() - t0) / 1000; if (py !== null) maxDy = Math.max(maxDy, Math.abs(e.position.y - py)); py = e.position.y; if (Math.floor(t * 2) !== last) { last = Math.floor(t * 2); console.log('[ride] ride5-strachan-under t ' + t.toFixed(1) + ' x ' + e.position.x.toFixed(1) + ' z ' + e.position.z.toFixed(1) + ' y ' + e.position.y.toFixed(2) + ' track ' + C.railLiftAt(e.position.x, e.position.z).toFixed(2) + ' v ' + (e.speed || 0).toFixed(1) + ' maxStep ' + maxDy.toFixed(3)); } if (t > 29.5) clearInterval(id); }, 50); })()
